nodes.summary: An 8,192-token prompt followed by 512 greedy decode tokens, measured after a warmup pass, reported as the median of five alternating A/B runs.
nodes.title: 8k-token prompt, 512-token greedy decode

effect.baseline_id: same build, same prompt, FP16 KV cache
effect.sample_note: Five alternating A/B pairs after one discarded warmup; the interval is the min and max of the five per-pair ratios, not a fitted confidence interval. Thermals were not instrumented and the host was otherwise idle. Contributor claim; not replicated.

nodes.summary: Switching the KV cache from FP16 to uniform 8-bit on a Qwen3-8B port raised decode throughput on an 8k-prompt workload by roughly six to eleven percent across five alternating A/B pairs. The gain is memory-bandwidth driven and should shrink at short context. No output-quality gate was run, so the quality cost of the quantized cache is unmeasured in this pack.
nodes.title: Uniform 8-bit KV cache on Qwen3-8B, Apple M3 Max

edges.rationale: The only change between the A and B legs was the KV cache dtype.
